quality_boundary: This inventory confirms official entry points, plan and implementation periods, annual progress publication, and fiscal document landings only. It does not promote indicators, survey results, administrative statistics, budget requests, approved amounts, settlement values, projects, or outcomes to Reviewed, linked, comparable, or policy-achievement status.
